data.summary:
Experience in people responsibilities, performance appraisal, career planning & development.
Project #1 Title AfterMarket Organization PhaseZero India LLP Role Principal Software Engineer Clients US Based Customers (10+) - Scientific Brake ,Quala,  OPW, Harman,Tectran ,etc. Duration Nov 2022- till date Environment Technologies: Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Spring JPA, Rest, Apache Kafka, Micro Services, Swagger UI Database: PostgreSQL Tools : IntelliJ IDEA, Git, JIRA Project concept Phase Zero is a Cloud 2.0 company providing SaaS based B2B E-Commerce platform (called Aftermarket) for commercial partners selling products such as Automotive Parts including Industrial Supplies. Responsibilities Analysing Business Requirement Documents (BRD) and translated them into functional specifications and technical solutions. Collaborating with the product team on sprint planning, backlog grooming, and user story refinement. Designed and implemented application structures based on user stories in a multi-tenant environment. Developed and maintained RESTful APIs, ensuring scalability and integration across multiple tenants. Led the Professional Services team, delivering custom client requirements with high quality and within deadlines. Acted as Customer Support Lead, managing and resolving P1/P2 issues, ensuring timely delivery and issue resolution. Integrated various third-party systems, including :ERP APIs (e.g., Karmak, Infor) ,Payment gateways (e.g., CardPointe, PayPal) Procurement platforms (e.g., Coupa) with eCommerce systems Estimated effort and timelines for tasks and deliverables for each release cycle. Conducted code reviews, defect triage, and bug fixing to maintain code quality and stability. Reviewed and tracked team members’ tasks and progress throughout sprints. Owned sprint releases to production, ensuring proper deployment and validation. Managed performance appraisals, career development, and planning for reportees. Project #2 Title EPM Organization Oracle Role Module Lead Client Oracle Duration September 2021- November 2022 Environment Technologies: Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Microservices, Swagger Open API, Tortoise GIT, IntelliJ and Maven, Post Man, Rabbit MQ . Project concept Oracle Cloud Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) Platform is a framework of the technical and functional components shared among Cloud EPM processes. It enables you to have a more unified user experience and simplified administration across different business functions. Responsibilities Involved in writing restful web service (CRUD Operations). Writing micro services using spring boot with cloud technologies Analysis, Design, Develop API and generating documentation using Swagger Open API definitions Immediate support to product team on any production issues Responsible for effort estimation of task for the release. As an individual developer owning the user stories and completing them Responsible for sprint release to production Responsible for deliverables in coding & testing and reviewing the same
